objective: FARO STUDIO PLAYBOOK 07 — Innovation Sprint: take a funded concept and produce a deep-dive proto-PRD ready for graphs/01-discovery.json. Read-only. Requires a specific concept name in the kickoff.

steps.task: Take the concept name named in the kickoff message and produce a detailed creative brief: expanded one-line pitch, full target user fantasy with persona sketch, core mechanic/interaction specification with user flow, emotional arc (what the user feels at each step), visual mood board description, 'why now' evidence, scope boundaries (what's in/out for v1.0), and 3 stretch goals for v1.1+. If the concept includes game mechanics, flag them for game-design review. Read products/<slug>/BRIEF.md and any existing ideation artifacts under products/ideas/ for context.

Only if the concept-deep-dive includes game mechanics: produce a game design deep-dive covering core loop specification, session length targets, retention hooks (D1/D7/D30), difficulty curve, on-device economy (sources/sinks table), and 30-second fun test. If the concept is not a game, return 'N/A — non-game concept.' Always respond in English.

Assess the concept-deep-dive output for technical and market feasibility. Check: on-device implementation possible? (zero backend, PWA constraints), store approval risks (Apple 4.2/5.1.1, Play Data Safety, permission declarations), estimated effort for v1.0 vs studio capacity, monetization model fit, and competitor response risk. Return: feasibility verdict (FEASIBLE / FEASIBLE-WITH-CAVEATS / NOT-FEASIBLE), specific blockers, effort range, and mitigation plan for each risk.

Transform the creative brief and feasibility assessment into a proto-PRD suitable as kickoff for graphs/01-discovery.json. Sections: Problem (evidence-backed), Audience (persona sketch from creativo), Solution (concept from creativo + feasibility from innovatore), MVP scope (v1.0 only, derived from scope boundaries), Out-of-scope, Success metrics (D1/D7/D30 targets), Risks (from innovatore), Store-review notes. End with a recommendation: PROCEED TO DISCOVERY or ITERATE-FURTHER. Always respond in English.

Reduce the proto-PRD into the Director's innovation sprint memo: concept name, proto-PRD summary, feasibility verdict, recommendation (PROCEED TO DISCOVERY vs ITERATE), and the exact kickoff command for graphs/01-discovery.json if PROCEED. Always respond in English.
